notes.title: Traffic Jams brings traffic chaos to Oculus Quest, PlayStation VR and Major PC VR Platforms in September!

[h1]Get your first hands-on with the first level of Traffic Jams in the demo on Steam![/h1]

In the world of Traffic Jams all traffic lights have gone out and you are the only one who can keep traffic flowing in the face of outrageous events and flagrant road rage. You start off in the quiet town of Gouda, but as you progress, traffic control job offers soon start pouring in from iconic cities around the globe. 

Rude pedestrians, impatient drivers, and the occasional meteorite will be yours to control before road rage strikes. Yes, you read that right; meteorites! But those aren’t the only hazards; This chaotic VR game is full of monsters, (un)natural disasters, and something called… ‘cheese bowling’?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301930/Traffic_Jams/

During the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-Z9Zp9wzha0][b]UploadVR Summer Showcase[/b][/url], we've announced couch party mode! Share the fun of VR with up to four friends (read: frenemies), locally, on mobile devices! Have a look at the multiplayer trailer featuring none other than VR content creators [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCN0FGqUt7e79xKoPAZQ8tww][b]Cas & Chary[/b][/url]!


[h1]Meet Dennis, your instructor.[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33738013/935f8e316a856f68af08343962adf863670f55b1.jpg[/img]

Dennis is your greatest frenemy, your rival, but most importantly, for better or for worse, your teacher. Hailing from Jam City, the self-proclaimed "best traffic controller...EVER", takes you under his wing. His experience comes from the many flash mobs and packed intersections that his hometown is known for. Armed with dreams of superstardom, a sassy attitude and fresh dance moves, he has taken it upon himself to teach YOU the ropes of traffic controlling.

If you give him a chance, (and the occasional dance), he'll take you on a jam-packed global adventure to become the Ultimate Traffic Showman.

This is only the first glimpse of the cities you’ll be handling in Traffic Jams, as there will be many different challenges, each with their own crazy events to face on this worldwide trip! [h1]Survive a vast, hostile world with seamless cooperative multiplayer made for VR[/h1]

We’re excited to finally reveal our biggest VR game yet: After the Fall, an epic, post-apocalyptic multiplayer VR action FPS. Survive a vast, hostile world with seamless co-op gameplay at its core.

Set in the post-apocalyptic, ice-covered ruins of an alternate 1980s Los Angeles, in After the Fall you play in a team of up to four players, against a vast, hostile world in a raging fight for control of the city and the survival of humanity. Go solo or join forces with players worldwide as you scavenge the remains of civilization, face relentless hordes and larger-than-life bosses, craft a huge range of guns and deadly close combat weapons, and wield devastating powers with real-life movements.

[url=https://youtu.be/_0kknW-iADw]Watch the E3 trailer here.[/url]

After the Fall combines an unprecedented VR world shared with players worldwide, a cinematic and atmospheric campaign, action-packed solo and multiplayer gameplay, and endgame built from the ground up for VR. You can register for beta access for a chance to play at [url=http://afterthefall-vr.com]http://afterthefall-vr.com[/url].

[b]A word from our Studio Director, Richard Stitselaar[/b]
“Arizona Sunshine was one of the first full-feature games developed exclusively for VR. Ever since, we’ve been eager to take it up a few notches and push hard at the boundaries of VR again. notes.title: A Fisherman’s Tale Out Now: Step into a world where physics are broken, and your every move is infinity replicated...
notes.notes:
[i][b]A Fisherman’s Tale Out Now: Step into a world where physics are broken, and your every move is infinity replicated...[/b]

A Fisherman’s Tale Out Now: Step into a world where physics are broken, and your every move is infinity replicated...[/i]

Innerspace VR and Vertigo Games are proud to announce that A Fisherman’s Tale, the mind-bending & multi-dimensional VR adventure is available from today for HTC Vive headsets for $14.99/EUR 14.99! 

A Fisherman’s Tale traps you inside a replica where you will need to work with infinite, ever smaller and bigger replications of yourself to find your way out of a world where physics are utterly broken.
 
Seeing is believing, so we’ve created a live-action launch trailer for you guys to check out! ==>

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uj0cxBlKK8c
[list]
[*] In a nutshell, A Fisherman’s Tale will have you:
[*] Break more than a couple laws of physics in mind-bending VR puzzles!
[*] Team up with yourself in revolutionary multi-dimensional single player co-op!
[*] Meet some of the quirkiest sidekicks to have ever set foot in a VR game
[*] Use your hands to pick up, throw, combine, and use all kinds of things in glorious fully immersive virtual reality!
[*] Toy around with your tiny little model lighthouse, inside a lighthouse, inside a... is that another lighthouse?
[*] Uncover the truth at the core of an unusually tall tale, exclusively in VR
[/list]

On top of that, A Fisherman’s Tale is a journey of both introspection and extrospection, asking players to both reach inside and outside of themselves for answers. What does it mean to reach the top of the lighthouse, and turn on the light?
 
Without VR, there wouldn’t have been an A Fisherman’s Tale. Our goal was to bring the adventure game genre to VR in a way that is meaningful to the genre. We hope you’ll think we succeeded!
 
We’re extremely excited for you to discover the game, and can’t wait to read your comments online!

Hi all,

Another update from our side. The 3rd patch for Skyworld is live, full patch notes are below. Among other things, this fulfills a recurring request from players: the option to switch on/off the table flip. By switching it off, you will instead of the table flip see a black fade.

    [*]Option to switch on/off table flip.

[h1]Balance tweaks:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Reworked towers and region rules.
    [*]Towers can now be destroyed even if the enemy general is in the same region.
    [*]Generals now need to stand next to the tower in order to defend them.
    [*]Reworked mission 3 end sequence:

	- Now does not respond to VIVE controller input anymore.
    [*]Fixed localization errors.
	- Fixed menus not adjusting after changing language.
	- Fixed text out of bound in panels.
    [*]Fixed paratrooper ghost incorrectly rotated.
    [*]Fixed voice lines being cut off in the combat arena.
    [*]Added voice effects for Jeffrey and the Overlord.

Thanks for playing and let us know your thoughts on this latest version of Skyworld below!

notes.title: Skyworld Patch 1 Now Live
notes.notes:
First off, a special thank you for your patience to those who have been waiting for their language to be implemented in the game.

We have now pushed our first update live on Steam and Oculus Home which not only includes a range of gameplay changes, bug fixes and additional features, but most of our planned in-game languages as well. 

Have a look at the patch notes below, give the new update a spin and let us know your thoughts on the discussion boards!

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Getting stuck at the end of mission 3
[*]Getting stuck in the mine section in mission 2
[*]Mission 8 reload issue
[*]Menu book not opening at the start of the game
[*]Tool tips sometimes not showing backgrounds
[*]Getting stuck on "Insane" after mission 3
[*]Re-center world view issue
[*]Occasional freeze upon level end
[*]Losing a worker pawn when holding it while destroying a building
[*]Multiplayer hosting improved
[*]Freeze upon changing graphical presets
[*]Bug showing Berserker in card
[*]Missing audio-files during battle
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]

[list]
[*]You can now only defend watchtowers while standing next to them with a general (instead of being in the same region)
[*]You can now revive a general even if an enemy general is your home region
Magic Barrier now clears active spells in its area, but these become active again afterwards
[*]Mission 3 now says "You've Escaped" when you complete it successfully
Spells are now cheaper to research (except Freeze)
[*]Upgrade costs for units level 2 (silver) and 3 (gold) are now more expensive
[*]Mission 2, 4, and 6 are now a little more easy in the beginning

notes.title: Post-launch content confirmed
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. Since the launch of Skyworld we've had an enormous amount of questions regarding post-launch content. This caught us off-guard as we were not planning to tackle this topic right away, but mostly focus on bug fixing for the first patch.

So, let's ditch that plan and let you in on our thoughts a bit sooner. Originally, we had aimed to announce our post-launch content once we had the visuals to show for them. However, given concerns that have been voiced, we can tell you plainly that yes, [b]there will be FREE post-launch content[/b]. We will follow up with an official announcement including visuals as soon as we can! Our first content update will include new skirmish maps in new environments and this is coming in weeks not months. 

We ask you allow us the time to develop this content and communicate it to you in a more complete manner. In addition to new content, there will be balance tweaks, implementation of our localization, and bug fixes in the near future as part of our support schedule. 

Finally, we’ve put a lot of love into this game, and we are not about to stop now. We hope to grow a healthy community for Skyworld. Let us know your thoughts and suggestions in the Steam discussion forums. We'll be reading and responding!

notes.title: Single Player Campaign Preview
notes.notes:
Your Highness, it is almost upon us. Your glorious reign is about to begin. I look forward to serving you as we remove the demons from your lands.  To that end, it would be most prudent for you to familiarize yourself with your new kingdom and how to manage it. I have prepared some tips for you in the video below. Additionally, sire, you will find more detail on your kingdom's economy and resource management in this proclamation.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8212938/c49d79bedfd46beba0388bb76230bb28f17fe77a.jpg[/img]
Recorded Twitch Preview of Single Player Campaign: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/180780447

Sire, as you can see there is much to be managed in your kingdom, but with the help of Lord Wadsworth, I am sure you will handle it all comfortably. To be certain of this, here is a brief review of the buildings available to construct.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8212938/57be14564ccbdf7e1300d23e58edf105fa1cc124.jpg[/img]

[b]Mill:[/b] The mill is one of the most vital buildings in your kingdom. It provides food for your citizens. Without enough food, you cannot sustain or grow your current population, causing you to lose workers needed for the production of other resources. Needless to say, your tax revenue suffers with fewer subjects. Less gold will make it harder to upgrade your units.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8212938/f9d01e750ef69c06f53a87d2aad1e849f086047c.jpg[/img]

[b]Saw Mill & Stone Quarry:[/b] These buildings create the necessary resources to build additional buildings and upgrade your castle and towers. Make sure to plan ahead for future construction by building enough of these buildings and assigning the correct amount of workers.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8212938/18b897f71342c5a7eb7dc39619543c8872ec8dcd.jpg[/img]

[b]Iron Mine & Magic Tower:[/b] These buildings are the backbone of your army, however you will never see them on the battlefield. They provide the necessary iron and magic needed to build new units and unlock new spells. Failure to manage these resources properly will show itself quite clearly on the battlefield.

notes.title: Skyworld Unit Preview
notes.notes:
Your Highness, while your heralds are away spreading the word of 'Ye Closed Beta' far and wide, I thought it would be appropriate to introduce you to some of your soldiers. There are over 20 units in your army, however your general asked me to introduce you to these units. They have been training most diligently and are eager to show you what they can do.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8212938/e5de3be64a8ce59a3c3e47084580ec77c7ca0821.jpg[/img]

Sire, knights are present in both your army and the enemy's. Your knights have chosen a fashionable blue to go along with their armor. They may be posh but pack one hell of swing. These units provide a significant area of effect damage and are excellent when used with other units that can absorb enemy damage.

As for the evil knight...fiery hair, fiery disposition. And he has big sword.

Countering him with a unit to tank and ranged units to deal damage is advisable.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8212938/7f7b766ca2bf0540099b51f5e89a82295d41cb81.jpg[/img]

Beware these manbeasts on the battlefield. They are insanely violent. Frankly, I would not stand near them if you were not with me, Sire. They are extreme damage dealers and can rip through enemy units. They are even more dangerous when wounded. They have been known to redouble their efforts, and damage, when low on health.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8212938/02ce6c57cbf8ed8843bb57a02665ce20761ca2dc.jpg[/img]

Often the last things enemy units see, these mechanical creations charge down the enemy and detonate when they get in range. Please take a few steps back just in case. 


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8212938/796537531bc88c406e44cfbb13e603c3370bcf6d.jpg[/img]

Sire, this next soldier is something special. The Operator can reach out and touch the enemy with ranged area of effect damage. While he doesn't say much, his machine gun talks loud and fast. 

The rapid rate of fire means he is dealing almost constant ranged damage.

notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8212938/3f77d313100fecbff93bdd3300ce4cc2306c35e2.png[/img]

Sire, your faithful steward has been preparing for the arrival of your closed beta guests. Following your 2015 proclamation, 'there shalt be a closed beta,' he has been busy putting in place all the arrangements necessary for the beginning of 'Ye Closed Beta.'

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8212938/16e3ac43d8ac4fb1effe74905fdbb748743c73b1.jpg[/img]

Preparations will be complete this October, so I felt it prudent to send forth the heralds to proclaim the good news throughout the land. Soon your guests will be able to experience all the wonder and beauty of your magical kingdom. I am sure they will come running as soon as the news reaches them.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8212938/dc008f9630ffa28766122b2b99509cf75d66c4fe.jpg[/img]

The proclamation reads:

Hear Ye! Hear Ye!
 
The King doth declare that Ye Closed Beta will begin this October 2017. All subjects wishing to participate must register for the Royal Herald's newsletter at [url=www.skyworld-game.com] skyworld-game.com[/url].
